name: nexus
description: Agent bridge - WebSocket server + terminal chat client

scripts.build: cd server && tsc && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('src/registry/agents.json','dist/registry/agents.json',{dereference:true});console.log('[build] copied agents.json')" && node -e "const f=require('fs'),c=f.readFileSync('dist/cli.mjs','utf8');if(!c.startsWith('#!')){f.writeFileSync('dist/cli.mjs','#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+c);console.log('[build] added shebang to cli.mjs')}"
scripts.demo:
echo '1. Run: npm run start   (in terminal 1)
2. Run: npm run chat    (in terminal 2)
3. Type a prompt to start opencode
4. Commands: /quit /cancel /model <name>
5. Prefix with claude/codex to use other agents'
